name: Trench Gorger — base power and toughness are the number of cards exiled with it when the trigger is fired
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "If you do, this creature has base power and base toughness each equal to the number of cards exiled this way" produced nothing. _lockFireTimeBasePT now counts the exile entries tagged to the source (exiledWithId) when the trigger is fired and writes "has base power and toughness N/N". Three lands exiled with it, one card in exile not tagged: 3/3. NOTE: exile ids are literal; build in its own process.
